message: git+https://example.test/tools/unnamed.git is built from source when installed (it comes from a git repository), which runs its build code, but depcurfew.json does not allow it
fix: Give the requirement a package name (name @ git+https://example.test/tools/unnamed.git) so that it can be allowed with "pypi:name" in installScripts.allow in depcurfew.json, or remove it
